data.title: Details Panel Hyperlinks and Center Button

epic.spec:
# Details Panel Hyperlinks and Center Button

Add interactive hyperlinks throughout the Detail Panel to enable quick navigation between related survey elements (shots, stations, sections), plus a "center on map" button in each detail header.

## Overview

The Detail Panel currently displays relationships between survey elements as static text. This feature adds clickable hyperlinks that change selection when clicked, enabling users to quickly navigate connected elements without manually finding them on the map.

**Two main components:**
1. **Hyperlinks** - Clickable element IDs that change selection
2. **Center Button** - Crosshairs icon in panel header that pans/zooms map to element

## Scope

**In scope:**
- DetailLink reusable component
- Hyperlinks in Shot, Station, Section detail views
- "Connected" bordered sections in Shot/Station details
- "Endpoints" bordered section in Section details
- Center button using existing `headerActions` prop
- Map centering for stations and shots (extend existing section pattern)
- ARIA live region for selection announcements
- Full keyboard accessibility

**Out of scope:**
- Tooltip previews on link hover
- Link visited state styling
- Map auto-center on link click (user requested no map change)

## Approach

### ID Format (from fn-20-mwj)
All IDs use `sectionId:position` format where position is 1-indexed:
- Station position = `station_index + 1`
- Shot position = `shot array index + 1`
- Section format: `sectionId: sectionName` or `sectionId: Unnamed`

### Shot-to-Station Mapping
Shot at index `i` (0-indexed) connects:
- Start station: `station_index = i`
- End station: `station_index = i + 1`

For 1-indexed display: shot position N connects stations N and N+1.

### Key Patterns to Reuse
- Selection: `setSelection()` from uiStore (pattern in SectionsPanel.tsx)
- Link styling: `text-accent underline` (existing pattern)
- Focus ring: `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:ring-inset` (existing pattern)
- ARIA live: `role="status" aria-live="polite"` (pattern in ShortcutRecorder.tsx:325-332)
- Map zoom: `triggerZoomToSection` pattern in uiStore.ts:149-151
- Map fit: `fitToSection()` pattern in MapCanvas.tsx:1186-1262

### Panel Component
Use existing `headerActions` prop (Panel.tsx:9,40-42) instead of adding new `rightAction` prop - functionally equivalent.

## Quick commands
```bash
# Type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Run Playwright tests
pnpm test:ui

# Run specific detail panel tests
pnpm test:ui --grep "detail"
```

## Key Files

| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `src/components/common/DetailLink.tsx` | New - reusable hyperlink component |
| `src/components/SingleSystemView/DetailPanel.tsx` | Add hyperlinks to StationDetail (L255-319), ShotDetail (L321-385), SectionDetail (L393-492) |
| `src/components/common/Panel.tsx` | Use existing `headerActions` for center button |
| `src/store/uiStore.ts` | Add `triggerCenterOnStation`, `triggerCenterOnShot` (pattern at L149-151) |
| `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx` | Add station/shot centering handlers (follow fitToSection at L1186-1262) |

## Dependencies

- **fn-20-mwj** (Data Table Improvements): Required for consistent ID format
- **fn-9-d6v** (Selection Highlighting): Uses selection system patterns

## Risks

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| Link target doesn't exist (deleted) | Show warning indicator, validate at render time |
| Duplicate ARIA announcements | Use single live region at DetailPanel level |
| Tab persistence confusion | Switch to Details tab when link clicked from Warnings |

## Acceptance

### Hyperlinks
- [ ] Shot detail shows Start Station and End Station links in "Connected" section
- [ ] Station detail shows Previous/Next Shot links (hidden at section boundaries)
- [ ] Section detail shows first/last station in "Endpoints" section
- [ ] All IDs use 1-indexed format: `sectionId:position`
- [ ] Clicking link changes selection and updates Detail Panel
- [ ] Clicking section link highlights section in Sections Panel
- [ ] Links use accent color + underline style
- [ ] Missing link targets show warning indicator
- [ ] Full keyboard accessibility (Tab + Enter)

### Center Button
- [ ] Crosshairs button in Shot, Station, Section detail headers (not Project Stats)
- [ ] Uses existing `headerActions` prop pattern
- [ ] Click pans and zooms map to fit element
- [ ] Full keyboard accessibility
- [ ] Dynamic aria-label per element type

### Accessibility
- [ ] All links have descriptive aria-labels: "Select [type] [id]"
- [ ] ARIA live region announces selection changes
- [ ] Focus ring meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards

### Testing
- [ ] Unit tests for DetailLink component
- [ ] Playwright E2E tests for link clicks and selection changes
- [ ] WebdriverIO tests for center button map behavior

### Documentation
- [ ] Update SPEC.md Section 6 with Detail Panel hyperlink patterns
- [ ] Update TESTING.md with new data-testid conventions

## References

- Panel.tsx `headerActions`: `src/components/common/Panel.tsx:9,40-42`
- Selection pattern: `src/store/uiStore.ts:56-99`
- Zoom pattern: `src/store/uiStore.ts:149-151`
- fitToSection: `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:1186-1262`
- ARIA live pattern: `src/components/Settings/ShortcutRecorder.tsx:325-332`
- Link styling: `src/components/SingleSystemView/DetailPanel.tsx:205`

# fn-21-q0u.1 Create DetailLink reusable component

## Description
Create a reusable `DetailLink` component for navigating between survey elements in the Detail Panel.

**Size:** S
**Files:** `src/components/common/DetailLink.tsx`

## Approach
- Use `<button>` element styled as link (actions that change state, not navigation)
- Follow existing link styling pattern at `DetailPanel.tsx:205`: `text-accent underline`
- Add focus ring: `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:ring-inset` (pattern in SectionsPanel.tsx:218)
- Props: `type` (station|shot|section), target ref/id, `displayText`, `onSelect` callback
- Handle missing target with warning indicator (yellow text or icon)

## Key context
- Use `<button>` not `<a>` - per a11y best practices, actions that change app state should be buttons
- aria-label format: "Select [type] [displayText]" (e.g., "Select station 2:5")
## Acceptance
- [ ] Component created at `src/components/common/DetailLink.tsx`

- [ ] Accepts `type`, target identifier, `displayText`, and `onSelect` props
- [ ] Includes descriptive `aria-label`
- [ ] Has `data-testid` following pattern: `{type}-{displayText}-link`
- [ ] Shows warning indicator when `isMissing` prop is true
- [ ] Full keyboard support (focusable, Enter activates)

# fn-21-q0u.2 Add station/shot centering infrastructure

## Description
Add infrastructure for centering the map on individual stations and shots, extending the existing section zoom pattern.

**Size:** M
**Files:** `src/store/uiStore.ts`, `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx`

## Approach

### uiStore.ts
Follow `triggerZoomToSection` pattern at L149-151:
- Add `requestCenterOnStation: StationRef | null`
- Add `triggerCenterOnStation(ref: StationRef)` action
- Add `clearCenterOnStationRequest()` action
- Same pattern for shots: `requestCenterOnShot: { sectionId: SectionId, shotId: ShotId } | null`

### MapCanvas.tsx
Follow `fitToSection()` pattern at L1186-1262:
- Add `fitToStation(stationRef: StationRef)` - use `easeTo()` with `point_zoom` config
- Add `fitToShot(sectionId, shotId)` - calculate shot midpoint, use `easeTo()`
- Wire up `useEffect` to listen to `requestCenterOnStation` and `requestCenterOnShot`

## Key context
- Single point centering uses `easeTo()` not `fitBounds()` (see L1241-1248)
- Use `mapConfig.point_zoom` for zoom level when centering on single point
- Shot midpoint = average of start and end station coordinates
## Acceptance
- [ ] uiStore has `requestCenterOnStation`, `triggerCenterOnStation`, `clearCenterOnStationRequest`
- [ ] uiStore has `requestCenterOnShot`, `triggerCenterOnShot`, `clearCenterOnShotRequest`
- [ ] MapCanvas has `fitToStation()` that centers map on station coordinates
- [ ] MapCanvas has `fitToShot()` that centers map on shot midpoint
- [ ] Both use `easeTo()` with smooth animation
- [ ] useEffect hooks respond to request state changes
- [ ] Unit tests for uiStore actions

# fn-21-q0u.3 Add hyperlinks and center button to ShotDetail

## Description
Add hyperlinks and center button to the ShotDetail component.

**Size:** M
**Files:** `src/components/SingleSystemView/DetailPanel.tsx` (ShotDetail function at L321-385)

## Approach

### New "Connected" section
Add bordered section after LRUD section (after L360) with:
- **Start Station**: Link to station at index = shot array index (1-indexed display)
- **End Station**: Link to station at index = shot array index + 1 (1-indexed display)
- **Section**: Link to section using format `sectionId: sectionName` or `sectionId: Unnamed`

### ID Format (from fn-20-mwj)
- Station display: `sectionId:stationPosition` where stationPosition = station_index + 1
- Section display: `sectionId: sectionName`

### Center Button
Add crosshairs button to Panel header using `headerActions` prop:
- Icon: Crosshairs from lucide-react
- onClick: Call `triggerCenterOnShot(section.id, shot.id)`
- aria-label: `Center map on shot {sectionId}:{shotPosition}`
- data-testid: `center-shot-button`

### Selection handlers
- Station link: `setSelection({ type: 'station', stationRef: { section_id, station_index } })`
- Section link: `setSelection({ type: 'section', sectionId })`
## Acceptance
- [ ] "Connected" bordered section appears after LRUD section
- [ ] Start Station link shows 1-indexed position and navigates to station
- [ ] End Station link shows 1-indexed position and navigates to station
- [ ] Section link shows `sectionId: name` format and navigates to section
- [ ] Crosshairs button in header calls `triggerCenterOnShot`
- [ ] All links use DetailLink component
- [ ] All links have proper aria-labels
- [ ] All links have data-testid attributes
- [ ] Clicking links updates selection correctly

data.title: Add ARIA live announcements for selection changes

tasks.spec: # fn-21-q0u.6 Add ARIA live announcements for selection changes ## Description Add ARIA live region to announce selection changes when hyperlinks are clicked. **Size:** S **Files:** `src/components/SingleSystemView/DetailPanel.tsx` ## Approach ### Live Region Add visually hidden live region at DetailPanel root level: ```tsx {selectionAnnouncement} ``` Follow existing pattern at `ShortcutRecorder.tsx:325-332`. ### Announcement Logic - Track previous selection in a ref - When selection changes AND it came from a DetailLink click, announce: - Station: "Selected station {sectionId}:{stationPosition}" - Shot: "Selected shot {sectionId}:{shotPosition}" - Section: "Selected section {sectionId}: {sectionName}" ### Implementation - Add `announcementRef` to track last announcement - DetailLink calls a `announceSelection` callback when clicked - DetailsContent manages the announcement state - Only announce when change originated from hyperlink (not map clicks) ## Key context - Use `aria-live="polite"` not "assertive" - selection is non-urgent - Keep live region always mounted (don't conditionally render) - Only announce DetailLink-triggered changes to avoid duplicate announcements ## Acceptance - [ ] Visually hidden live region exists at DetailPanel root - [ ] Selection changes from hyperlink clicks are announced - [ ] Announcement format: "Selected {type} {id}" - [ ] Uses `aria-live="polite"` for non-urgent updates - [ ] Live region always mounted (not conditionally rendered) - [ ] Does not announce selection changes from other sources (map clicks) ## Done summary TBD ## Evidence - Commits: - Tests: - PRs:

# fn-21-q0u.7 Playwright E2E tests for hyperlinks and center button

## Description
Create comprehensive Playwright E2E tests for hyperlinks and center button functionality.

**Size:** M
**Files:** `e2e-playwright/detail-panel-links.spec.ts` (new), `e2e-playwright/mocks/tauri-ipc.ts` (update)

## Approach

### Test Scenarios
1. **Shot Detail Links**
   - Click Start Station link → selection changes to station
   - Click End Station link → selection changes to station
   - Click Section link → selection changes to section, highlights in Sections Panel

2. **Station Detail Links**
   - Click Previous Shot link → selection changes to shot
   - Click Next Shot link → selection changes to shot
   - First station: Previous Shot not visible
   - Last station: Next Shot not visible
   - Merged station links clickable

3. **Section Detail Links**
   - Click First Station link → selection changes
   - Click Last Station link → selection changes
   - Single-station section shows "Only Station"

4. **Center Buttons**
   - Click center button → verify map state request triggered
   - Button has correct aria-label
   - Button keyboard accessible (Tab + Enter)

5. **Keyboard Navigation**
   - Tab through links in detail panel
   - Enter activates focused link
   - Focus ring visible

6. **Accessibility**
   - All links have aria-labels
   - Live region announces selection changes

### Mock Updates
Update `tauri-ipc.ts` to return test data with multiple sections, shots, and stations for testing navigation scenarios.

## Description
Create WebdriverIO tests for map centering functionality (requires real Tauri app).

**Size:** S
**Files:** `e2e/specs/detail-panel-center.spec.ts` (new)

## Approach

### Test Scenarios
1. **Center on Station**
   - Select a station in detail panel
   - Click center button
   - Verify map has panned (check map center coordinates changed)

2. **Center on Shot**
   - Select a shot in detail panel
   - Click center button
   - Verify map has panned to shot midpoint

3. **Center on Section**
   - Select a section in detail panel
   - Click center button
   - Verify map shows entire section (fitBounds behavior)

### Setup
- Import test DMP file with multiple sections
- Navigate to specific elements for testing

## Key context
- WebdriverIO tests run against real Tauri app
- Use `./scripts/wdio.sh --spec e2e/specs/detail-panel-center.spec.ts` to run
- Can't easily verify exact map position, but can verify map state changed
